title: Orders across two clouds
subtitle: An order lands on AWS and is invoiced on Google Cloud

nodes.label: CloudFront
nodes.detail: Sits in front of the API and answers from the nearest location.

nodes.label: API Gateway
nodes.detail: Checks the caller, then invokes the Orders function.

nodes.label: Orders function
nodes.detail: Runs on Lambda: saves the order, then queues its invoice.

nodes.label: Orders table
nodes.detail: Holds every order. It is written before the invoice is queued.

nodes.label: Invoice queue
nodes.detail: Decouples the two clouds: orders keep coming even if invoicing is slow.

nodes.label: Invoice service
nodes.detail: Reads each queued order, builds the invoice and sends it.

nodes.label: Ledger function
nodes.detail: Posts one ledger entry per invoice.

beats.title: The app asks the edge
beats.caption: One HTTPS request, answered from the nearest edge.

beats.title: The edge forwards the call
beats.caption: The request moves on to the gateway.

beats.title: An invoice is queued
beats.caption: The customer does not wait for it.

beats.title: The queue hands over
beats.caption: The one hop that crosses from AWS to Google Cloud.

beats.title: The ledger is posted
beats.caption: Cloud Run builds the invoice, then a function posts the entry.
